changeSet.author: your-name
changeSet.comment: Change the reference generated column prefix from NRF- to NRL-. Postgres cannot alter a generated column's expression in place, so the column is dropped and re-added with the new expression. Re-adding recomputes the value for every existing row, so all references (existing and new) are re-issued with the NRL- prefix. The id-to-reference mapping is unchanged apart from the prefix (same multiplier and lpad), so lookups by reference must use the new value.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE quotes DROP COLUMN reference;

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE quotes DROP COLUMN reference;
